issues.title: MTN Uganda launches Digida Season II as Y’ello Storm brings new network sites, community support to Luweero Referral Hospital

issues.summary: Luweero, Uganda | THE INDEPENDENT | MTN Uganda launched the second season of its Digida Caller Tunez promotion in Luweero on Friday, combining customer rewards with new network sites and community support as part of its Y’ello Storm campaign. Customers who activate their preferred MTN Caller Tunez by dialing *170*12# will stand a chance to ...
